blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用作人类语言处理的计算模型,然而仍然不清楚其表达的哪个组成部分驱动与神经活性相协调. 在这里,我们利用脊下级回归来识别LLM表达的大脑预测子空间:支持神经反应线性预测的表达方向. 跨越三个自然语言学语言学语言学和fMRI的数据集, 以及六个模型条件, 跨越自旋性,双向遮掩,随机初始化的语言模型, 我们发现完全的线性编码性能 只能使用 原始嵌入维度的 1-3 。 这些低维子空间泛指被搁置的参与者,在较小的程度上指跨数据集,说明神经预测力集中在一个紧凑而部分共享的代表性空间. 我们接下来将这些大脑预测方向 与嵌入物中的主要变化轴进行对比 主要组成部分分析需要大大地增加维度来恢复神经预测,表明预测神经活性最有用的方向与记录LLM表达本身最总体差异的方向不同. 最后,对所学到的子空间进行特征分析,使我们能够在LLM表达值之上和之外神经活性中出现过多的可解释特征。 这些结果共同表明,LLM-大脑对接得到一小段结构化的模型表示的支持,并为更好地理解这些表示为何一致提供了一个框架。 代码见:https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-ignment

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are strong predictors of human neural activity during language processing and are increasingly used as computational models of language comprehension ( Schrimpf et al., 2021 ; Goldstein et al., 2022 ; Mischler et al., 2024 ; Zada et al., 2024 ) . Yet it remains unclear which components of their high-dimensional representations drive this alignment. Prior work has related neural predictivity to properties such as training objective, model scale, layer depth, intrinsic dimensionality, and representational generality ( Antonello et al., 2023 ; Antonello and Huth, 2024 ; Antonello and Cheng, 2024 ) . However, these model-level relationships do not identify the specific representational directions that support neural prediction, and apparent differences in alignment can also be influenced by confounds in the evaluation process ( Hadidi et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)是语言处理过程中人类神经活性的强预测器,并被越来越多地用作语言理解的计算模型(Schrimpf等,2021;Goldstein等,2022;Mischler等,2024;Zada等,2024). 然而,仍然不清楚它们高维度表述的哪些组成部分推动了这种一致性。 先前的工作与训练目标,模型尺度,地层深度,内在维度等属性相关的神经预测性,以及代表性通论(Antonello等,2023;Antonello和Huth,2024;Antonello和Cheng,2024). 然而,这些模型层面的关系并没有确定支持神经预测的具体表现方向,对齐的明显差异也可能被评价过程中的错位所影响(Hadidi等,2026).

blocks.en: Here, we take a complementary approach. Rather than asking which global properties of a model correlate with its neural predictivity, we ask which part of the model representation actually supports that prediction. Conceptually, we view LLM–brain alignment as arising from information shared between features represented by an LLM and measured neural responses (figure 1 a). Under a linear encoding model, we operationalize this shared information as a brain-predictive subspace of the LLM representation: the set of representational directions that are useful for predicting neural activity. This framing turns a single encoding score into a representational object that can itself be studied.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,我们采取补充性办法。 我们不问一个模型的哪些全球性特性与其神经预测性相关,而是问模型表述中哪部分实际支持这一预测。 从概念上讲,我们认为LLM-脑部的调整产生于以LLM为代表的特征和所测量的神经反应之间共享的信息(图1a)。 在一个线性编码模型下,我们把这个共享的信息作为LLM代表的大脑预想子空间——一套对预测神经活性有用的表达方向实现. 这个框架将单个编码分数转换为可以自己研究的表示对象.

blocks.en: Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six different language models we use reduced rank regression (RRR) ( Izenman, 1975 ) to discover this brain-predictive subspace and find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered from only  1–3% of the original embedding dimensions. These brain-predictive subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, partially, across datasets. We then compare each learned subspace against one learned by Principal Component Analysis (PCA) applied only to the LLM embeddings. We find that there is a mismatch between the directions of principal variance in the embeddings as learned from an unsupervised PCA and the directions most useful for neural prediction; suggesting differences in the representational geometry of the two systems. Finally, feature-decoding analyses reveal interpretable differences in the linguistic information emphasized by these subspaces across datasets and recording modalities. Together, these results show that LLM–brain alignment is supported by a compact, structured subset of model representations and provide a framework for identifying which components of those representations drive neural predictivity.
blocks.zh: 纵观三个自然语言学语言列表数据集,它们跨越了颅内电生学和fMRI,以及六个不同的语言模型,我们使用降级回归(RRR)(Izenman,1975年)来发现这个大脑预测子空间,发现完全的线性编码性能只能从原始嵌入维数的1-3%恢复. 这些大脑预测子空间泛指所有被搁置的参与者,并部分覆盖数据集。 然后,我们把每个学习到的子空间与主要组件分析(PCA)只应用于LLM嵌入的子空间进行比较。 我们发现,从无监督的五氯苯甲醚中学到的嵌入物中主要差异的方向与对神经预测最有用的方向之间有不匹配之处;这表明两种系统在代表几何上的区别。 最后,特征解码分析揭示出这些子空间所强调语言信息在数据集和记录方式上的可解释差异. 这些结果表明,LLM-大脑对接由一个紧凑的、结构化的模型表示子集支持,并为确定这些表示的哪些组成部分驱动神经预测提供了一个框架。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Motivation
blocks.zh: 2 背景和动机

blocks.en: 2.1 Language Encoding Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 语言编码模型

blocks.en: Encoding models test whether a candidate representational space captures information present in neural responses. In language neuroscience, this approach has progressed from investigator-defined semantic features to contextual representations learned by neural language models, which predict activity across fMRI, MEG, and intracranial recordings ( Huth et al., 2016 ; Jain and Huth, 2018 ; Toneva and Wehbe, 2019 ; Schrimpf et al., 2021 ; Goldstein et al., 2022 ; Caucheteux and King, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 编码模型测试候选代表空间是否捕捉神经反应中的信息. 在语言神经科学方面,这种方法从调查员定义的语义特征发展到神经语言模型所学的上下文表现,这些上下文预测了跨fMRI,MEG和颅内录制的活性(Huth等,2016;Jain和Huth,2018;Toneva和Wehbe,2019;Schrimpf等,2021;Goldstein等,2022;Caucheteux和King,2022).

blocks.en: LLM representations are effective encoding spaces because they capture many aspects of language simultaneously, but this also complicates their interpretation. A single layer may contain thousands of distributed features reflecting lexical, syntactic, semantic, contextual, and predictive information, any combination of which may support neural prediction. Thus, successful encoding establishes that neurally relevant information is linearly accessible from the representation but does not reveal which components carry that signal.
blocks.zh: LLM表示是有效的编码空间,因为它们同时捕捉了语言的许多方面,但这也使其解释复杂化了. 单层可能包含上千个分布式特征,反映词汇学,综合学,语义学,上下文学,和预测学信息,其组合可能支持神经预测. 因此,成功的编码可以确定神经相干的信息可以从表示器中线性地取出,但并不显示哪个组件带有该信号.

blocks.en: Prior work has related neural predictivity to properties including next-word prediction performance, model scale, layer depth, representational generality, intrinsic dimensionality, and particular linguistic or computational features ( Schrimpf et al., 2021 ; Antonello and Huth, 2024 ; Antonello and Cheng, 2024 ; Kumar et al., 2024 ; Mischler et al., 2024 ) . These results constrain possible explanations of LLM–brain alignment but primarily characterize representations globally rather than identifying the specific directions responsible for prediction.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作将神经预测性与属性相关,包括下个字的预测性能,模型尺度,地层深度,代表通性,内在维度,以及特定的语言或计算特征(Schrimpf等,2021;Antonello和Huth,2024;Antonello和Cheng等,2017年). 2024; Kumar等, 2024; Mischler等, 2024.). 这些结果限制了对LLM-大脑协调的可能解释,但主要是全球代表性的特点,而不是确定负责预测的具体方向。

blocks.en: 2.2 Brain-Predictive Subspaces
blocks.zh: 2.2 大脑预测子空间

blocks.en: Prior work suggests that both language representations and their relationship to neural activity exhibit low-dimensional structure. Antonello et al. (2021) identified low-dimensional organization in linguistic representations related to fMRI predictivity, while Lewis et al. (2025) used low-rank constraints to factorize LLM-to-MEG encoding models into interpretable semantic, temporal, and spatial components.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作表明,语言表现及其与神经活性的关系都表现出了低维结构. 安东内洛等. (2021)识别出与fMRI预测性相关的语言表达中的低维组织,而Lewis等(2025)则使用低等限制将LLM-到-MEG编码模型纳入可解释的语义,时间,和空间成分.

blocks.en: These approaches motivate a more direct question: how much of an individual LLM representation is actually required to recover its neural predictivity? Reduced-rank regression provides a supervised way to answer this question by identifying low-dimensional directions chosen specifically for their ability to predict neural responses. This distinguishes the brain-predictive subspace from unsupervised low-dimensional structure, such as the principal variance directions identified by PCA, and provides a representation whose dimensionality, generalization, and linguistic content can be studied directly.
blocks.zh: 这些方法引发了一个更直接的问题:要恢复神经预测性,需要多少个人LLM代表? 降级回归通过识别专门为其预测神经反应能力所选择的低维方向,为回答这个问题提供了一个有监督的方法. 这将大脑预测子空间与不受监督的低维结构区分开来,如PCA确定的主要差异方向,并提供了一种能直接研究其维度,通论,和语言内容的表示.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) We view alignment as a measure of the linear features shared by the LLM embedding space and the neural response space. Our goal is to selectively extract the intersection of the two spaces. (b) Our pipeline. We learn two low-rank representations of the model embeddings and use them to predict neural data. The PCA space (green) prioritizes capturing the directions of principal variation in the LLM embeddings. The RRR space (blue) prioritizes the directions which best align between the two representational spaces teasing out the aligned subspace. (c) To identify the size of the aligned subspace we sweep the subspace rank, fit new models and re-evaluate. We find the point at which our RRR space performance saturates and compare it to the PCA point of saturation. (d) Leave-one-subject-out experiment. We fit the RRR space on all but one subject and then transfer the projection matrix to a held-out subject and fit a new mapping to that subject’s neural data. (e) We again sweep over ranks and compare the point of saturation on the held-out subject between the RRR space fit on all subjects, RRR space fit on all but the held-out subject, and the unsupervised PCA space.
blocks.zh: 图1: (a) 将校正视为LLM嵌入空间和神经反应空间共有线性特征的衡量尺度。 我们的目标是有选择地取出两个空间的相交点. (b) 我们的管道。 我们学习了模型嵌入的两个低等代表,并用它们来预测神经数据. 五氯苯甲醚空间(绿色)优先捕捉LLM嵌入物中主要变化的方向。 RRR空间(蓝色)优先排列两个代表空间之间最佳对接的方向取出对接的子空间. (c) 为了确定对齐的子空间的大小,我们扫清了子空间的分级,适应了新的模型并进行了重新评估。 我们发现我们的RRR空间性能饱和点,并将其与PCA饱和点相比较. (d) 留一试题。 我们把RRR的空间 放在除一个外的所有主题上 然后把投影矩阵转移到一个被搁置的主体上 并重新绘制出该主体的神经数据 (e) 我们再次扫清排行并比较所有主体的RRR空间、除被搁置主体外所有主体的RRR空间和无监督的PCA空间之间被搁置主题的饱和度。

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We analyzed three datasets of neural responses to naturalistic spoken language. The Podcast ECoG dataset contains high-gamma (70–200 Hz) recordings from nine participants and 1,330 intracranial electrodes collected during a 30-minute narrative podcast ( Zada et al., 2025 ) . Brain Treebank contains stereoelectroencephalography (sEEG) recordings from participants viewing movies ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ; we analyzed Cars 2 , which contained the most heard words ( ∼ \sim 8,000) viewed by at least three participants. The Deep fMRI dataset contains responses to spoken stories collected across five recording sessions ( LeBel et al., 2023 ) ; we analyzed eight participants and evaluated encoding models on the repeated held-out test story.
blocks.zh: 我们分析了自然语言的三个神经反应数据集。 Podcast ECoG数据集包含9名参与者的高伽玛(70-200赫兹)录音和在30分钟的叙事播客中采集的1,330个颅内电极(Zada等,2025年)。 Brain Treebank包含来自观众观看电影(Wang等, 2024年)的立体电能学(sEEG)录音;我们分析了车厢2, Depen fMRI数据集包含对五场录制会议(LeBel等,2023年)所收集的口语故事的回应;我们分析了8名参与者,并评价了重复的搁置测试故事的编码模型.

blocks.en: 3.2 Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.2 预处理

blocks.en: We used the released high-gamma responses for Podcast and preprocessed Brain Treebank recordings to extract 70–200 Hz high-gamma activity. Both intracranial datasets were aligned to word onset and sampled at 32 Hz. We used the released preprocessed fMRI responses. Full preprocessing details are provided in Appendix A.1.
blocks.zh: 我们用释放出来的高伽玛反应 用于Podcast和预处理的脑树银行录音 提取70 -200赫兹高伽玛活性。 两个颅内数据集都与出字相接并被取样为32赫兹. 我们使用了已发布的预处理 fMRI 响应。 完整的预处理细节见附录A.1。

blocks.en: 3.3 Language models
blocks.zh: 3.3 语文模式

blocks.en: We extracted word representations from four autoregressive models—GPT-2, GPT-2 XL, GPT-J 6B, and Llama 3 8B—and the bidirectional masked language model RoBERTa Large ( Radford et al., 2019 ; Wang and Komatsuzaki, 2021 ; AI@Meta, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2019 ) . We additionally analyzed a randomly initialized GPT-2 control as such controls have been studied in previous work as well as a non-contextual 300-dimensional GloVe embeddings ( Schrimpf et al., 2021 ; Hosseini et al., 2024 ; Pennington et al., 2014 ) . For each contextual model, we sampled five layers at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% depth. Additional embedding-generation details are provided in Appendix A.1.1.
blocks.zh: 我们从四个自旋模型——GPT-2,GPT-2 XL,GPT-J 6B,和Llama 3 8B——以及双向口罩语言模型RoBERTa Large(拉德福德等,2019年;王和相崎,2021年;AI@Meta,2017年)中提取出单词表示. 2024; 刘等, 2019. ). 此外,我们还对随机初始化的GPT-2控制进行了分析,因为以往的工作已经研究了这种控制以及非文字300维GloVe嵌入(Schrimpf等,2021;Hosseini等,2024;Pennington等,2014)。 在每个背景模型中,我们以0%、25%、50%、75%和100%的深度对5个层进行了取样。 附录A.1.1提供了其他嵌入生成细节。

blocks.en: 3.4 Selection of neural targets
blocks.zh: 3.4 选择神经目标

blocks.en: Because our goal was to estimate the rank of the subspace supporting general neural alignment, we used a broad target-selection procedure designed to retain reliable signal linking LLM embeddings to neural activity while excluding clearly noisy targets. We selected recording sites using held-out predictions from full-embedding ridge encoding models. Significance was assessed against null distributions generated by circularly shifting neural responses, with Benjamini–Hochberg correction across recording sites. For iEEG, selected electrodes contributed all sampled lags as RRR targets; for fMRI, selected voxels were used directly. Additional selection details and target counts are provided in Appendix A.5.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的目标是估算支持一般神经调和的子空间的级别,我们使用了广泛的目标选择程序,旨在保留连接LLM嵌入与神经活性的可靠信号,同时排除明显吵闹的目标. 我们选择了记录站 使用预言 从全嵌入脊编码模型。 根据循环变化的神经反应产生的无效分布来评估其意义,Benjamini-Hochberg的校正横跨录制网站。 对于iEEG,所选电极作为RRR目标贡献出所有被采样的滞后;对于fMRI,所选的活塞被直接使用. 附录A.5提供了其他选择细节和目标数。

blocks.en: 3.5 Encoding models
blocks.zh: 3.5 编码模型

blocks.en: We first fit ridge encoding models using the full embedding space to establish a reference performance for each model and layer. For iEEG, word embeddings predicted electrode responses at sampled lags relative to word onset, with performance evaluated using five contiguous held-out word folds. For fMRI, embeddings were aligned to acquisition times and used to construct a four-delay finite impulse response design; models were evaluated on held-out stories. Ridge penalties were selected by cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先安装了山脊编码模型,利用了完整的嵌入空间,为每个模型和地层建立参考性能. 对于iEEG,在被抽取的后差时,单词嵌入会预测出电极响应,与单词发起相比,其性能使用相接的5个被悬浮的单词折叠来评价. 就fMRI而言,嵌入与获取时间一致,并用于构建一个四延的有限冲动响应设计;模型被评价在被搁置的故事上. 岭上处罚通过交叉鉴定选择.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Low-rank RRR recovers neural predictivity more efficiently than PCA. (a) Example rank-performance curves for GPT-J-6b layer 21 across the three datasets. (b) Mean convergence across model-layers showing RRR converges quicker than PCA. Generated by normalizing by max performance and enforcing monotonicity before averaging. (c) Saturation ranks for matched model–layer combinations, defined as the minimum rank at which all informative target-performance quantiles reach 99% of their maximum. RRR saturates at substantially lower rank than PCA across all three datasets. See Methods and Appendix for threshold and significance details.
blocks.zh: 图2:低等RRR比PCA更能高效地恢复神经预测. (a) 跨越三个数据集的GPT-J-6b 第21层的等效曲线。 (b) 模型层之间平均趋同,显示RRR的趋同速度快于PCA。 由最大性能的常态化产生,并在平均前强制单调. (c) 匹配的模型-层组合的饱和等级,被定义为所有信息化的目标性能等分数达到其最大值的99%的最低等级。 在所有三个数据集中,RRR的饱和度大大低于五氯苯甲醚。 门槛和意义细节见方法和附录。

blocks.en: 3.6 Reduced-rank regression
blocks.zh: 3.6 降级回归

blocks.en: We used ridge reduced-rank regression (RRR) ( Izenman, 1975 ) to identify the optimal rank k k subspace of embeddings for neural prediction (Figure 1 b). Within each training partition, we fit a multivariate ridge model from embeddings ( X X ) to neural responses ( Y Y ), producing coefficients ( W W ) and fitted responses ( Y ^ = X ​ W \hat{Y}=XW ). We decomposed ( Y ^ \hat{Y} ) and used its leading ( k k ) right singular vectors ( V k V_{k} ) to construct an input factor ( A k = W ​ V k A_{k}=WV_{k} ), whose columns span embedding directions associated with the leading components of predicted neural activity.
blocks.zh: 我们利用了脊平降级回归(RRR)(Izenman,1975年)来确定嵌入神经预测的最佳阶地克子空间(图1b). 在每次训练分区内,我们安装了从嵌入(X X)到神经应答(Y Y)的多变量山脊模型,生成系数(W W)并安装了应答(Y ^ = X W\hat{Y}=X W ). 我们分解了(Y ^\hat{Y}),并使用了它的领先(kk)右单向向向量(V k V_{k})来构造一个输入因子(A k = W V k A_{k}=WVk}k}),其列横跨了与预测神经活性的主要成分相关的嵌入方向.

blocks.en: At each rank ( k k ), we projected embeddings into an orthonormalized version of this subspace and fit a new ridge encoding model using the projected data. We swept ranks from one to the available embedding-dimensionality endpoint to determine how quickly neural prediction was recovered as the bottleneck increased (figure 1 c). Performance was evaluated on held-out neural responses, with the full-embedding ridge model serving as the reference. For fMRI, we combined the delay-specific RRR factors into a single orthonormal basis in the original embedding coordinates; details are provided in Appendix A.2.2.
blocks.zh: 在每个级别(k k)上,我们预测嵌入这个子空间的正态化版本,并使用所预测的数据安装出一个新的脊编码模型. 我们从一个到现有的嵌入-维度端点横扫了各行各业,以确定随着瓶颈增加,神经预测恢复的速度(图1c)。 对搁置神经反应的性能进行了评价,以全嵌入脊模型为参考. 就fMRI而言,我们将特定延迟的RRR因子合并为原始嵌入坐标中的单一正态基;详情见附录A.2.2.

blocks.en: We compared RRR with principal component analysis (PCA) of the training embeddings (figure 1 b). At each rank, embeddings were projected onto the leading principal components and evaluated using the same ridge refitting and held-out data.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了RRR与培训嵌入的主要组成部分分析(图1b)。 在每个级别上,将嵌入物投放到主要部件上,并使用相同的脊接和被搁置的数据进行评估。

blocks.en: 3.7 Saturation rank
blocks.zh: 3.7 饱和等级

blocks.en: To summarize how quickly predictive performance was recovered as rank increased (figure 1 c), we defined a saturation rank using the distribution of performance across neural targets. At each rank, we computed the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, and 90th percentiles of held-out target performance and tracked each quantile across the rank sweep. Saturation rank was defined as the minimum rank at which all informative quantile curves reached at least 99% of their respective maximum performance. Quantiles whose maximum performance did not exceed 0.005 were excluded. This criterion captures recovery across the target-performance distribution rather than relying on mean performance alone. Additional motivation and threshold-sensitivity analyses are provided in Appendix A.3.
blocks.zh: 为了总结预测性能随着分级提高而恢复的速度(图1c),我们用神经目标间性能的分布来定义了饱和分级. 每个级别,我们计算第10,第25,第50,第75和第90百分位的被搁置目标性能,并追踪每个四分位数横扫级别。 饱和分级被定义为所有信息量级曲线达到各自最大性能至少99%的最低分级. 最大性能不超过0.005的量子不包括在内。 这一标准涵盖整个目标业绩分配的恢复情况,而不是仅仅依靠平均业绩。 附录A.3提供了其他动机和阈值敏感性分析。

blocks.en: 3.8 Generalization analyses
blocks.zh: 3.8 一般分析

blocks.en: To assess cross-participant generalization, we held out one participant at a time and learned an RRR subspace from the remaining participants (figure 1 d). We transferred this subspace to the held-out participant and fit a new encoding model using only that participant’s neural responses. We then compared transferred RRR with RRR learned from the held-out participant and with PCA across ranks (figure 1 e).
blocks.zh: 为了评估跨参与者的概括性,我们一次抓住一名参与者,并从其余参与者那里学习了RRR子空间(图1d)。 我们把这个子空间转移到了被搁置的参与者身上, 并安装了一个新的编码模型, 只使用参与者的神经反应。 然后,我们把转移的RRR与从被搁置的参与者那里学到的RRR和跨等级的PCA进行比较(图1e)。

blocks.en: For cross-dataset transfer, we learned an RRR or PCA subspace from a source dataset and projected the target dataset’s embeddings into that space. A new ridge model was then fit and evaluated using only target-dataset neural responses. Thus, in both generalization analyses, only the embedding subspace was transferred; the mapping from that subspace to neural activity was estimated separately in the target participant or dataset.
blocks.zh: 在跨数据集传输方面,我们从源数据集中学习了RRR或PCA子空间,并预测了目标数据集嵌入该空间的情况. 然后,只使用目标数据集神经反应来适应和评估新的脊模型。 因此,在两次概括分析中,只有嵌入子空间被转移;从该子空间到神经活性的绘图在目标参与者或数据集中分别估算出.

blocks.en: 3.9 Language-feature decoding
blocks.zh: 3.9 语言特征解码

blocks.en: To characterize the information preferentially represented in brain-predictive subspaces, we annotated stimulus words with lexical, syntactic, semantic, discourse, timing, and pause features. At each rank, we projected embeddings into the RRR and PCA spaces and trained held-out decoders for each available feature. Continuous features were evaluated using Pearson correlation and categorical features using balanced accuracy. The complete feature set and decoding details are provided in Appendix A.7.
blocks.zh: 为了描述在大脑预测子空间中 优先代表的信息, 我们用词汇、合成、语义、话语、时间和暂停功能 来注释刺激词。 在每个级别上,我们预测嵌入RRR和PCA空间,并为每个可用的功能培训了被搁置的解码器. 利用皮尔逊关系和平衡准确的绝对特征对连续特征进行了评价。 完整的功能设置和解码细节见附录A.7.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Alignment Relies on a Low-Rank Subspace
blocks.zh: 4.1 低倾角子空间上的对齐

blocks.en: Figure 3: Brain-predictive subspaces generalize across held-out participants. (a) Example rank–performance curves for within-participant RRR, transferred RRR learned from the remaining participants, and PCA. (b) Mean convergence curves across models and layers. (c) Saturation ranks for matched model–layer combinations. Transferred RRR reaches near-maximal performance at substantially lower rank than PCA and is generally comparable to within-participant RRR.
blocks.zh: 图3:脑预知子空间泛指所有被搁置的参与者。 (a) 参与者内部RRR的绩效曲线实例,从其他参与者和常设仲裁法院学到的RRR。 (b) 跨模型和分层的平均趋同曲线。 (c) 匹配的模型-层组合的饱和度排名。 转移的RRR达到近乎最大性能,其级别大大低于PCA,一般与参与者内的RRR相当.

blocks.en: To estimate the dimensionality of the LLM representation required to recover its full neural predictivity, we fit ridge reduced-rank regression (RRR) in each of our three datasets and measured encoding performance as we varied the rank of the predictive bottleneck (Figure 2 ; see Appendix for full encoding-model results). Across datasets, models, and layers, performance typically peaked at ranks substantially below the full embedding dimensionality, with low-rank RRR models often outperforming the corresponding full-space ridge baseline (Figure 2 a). This improvement was not observed in PCA-based dimensionality reduction, indicating that it is not simply a consequence of compressing the embedding space. Instead, the result is consistent with RRR preferentially retaining directions that are informative for predicting neural responses while discarding dimensions that contribute little useful predictive signal. Moreover, RRR saturates at only tens of dimensions across all three datasets and across model layers—for example, a mean rank of 20 in the Podcast dataset—whereas PCA generally requires hundreds of dimensions to achieve comparable performance (Figure 2 c). Thus, the directions that support neural prediction constitute a much lower-dimensional subspace than would be inferred from the dominant axes of variance in the embeddings themselves. This low-rank finding is consistent across models, layers, and recording modalities. Whether the same brain-predictive subspaces generalize across participants, stimuli, and datasets, however, remains an open question addressed in the following analyses.
blocks.zh: 为了估计恢复其全部神经预测性所需的LLM表示的维度,我们在我们三个数据集的每个数据集中都配有被降低的等分回归(RRR),并在我们改变预测瓶颈的等级时测量编码性能(图2;完整的编码模型结果见附录)。 在所有数据集、模型和地层中,性能一般都达到峰值,远远低于完全嵌入维度,低等RRR模型往往优于相应的全空间脊基线(图2a)。 在基于五氯苯甲醚的维度减少中没有观察到这种改进,这表明这不仅仅是压缩嵌入空间的结果。 相反,结果与RRR优先保留方向是一致的,这些方向对预测神经反应具有信息性,而放弃那些对预测信号作用不大的维度. 此外,所有三个数据集和模型层的RRR饱和度都只有几十个维度——例如,Podcast数据集的中位数为20——由于PCA一般需要上百个维度才能达到可比较的性能(图2 c)。 因此,支持神经预测的方向构成了比嵌入物本身中差异的主要轴所推断出的更低维的子空间. 这种低等级的发现在模型,分层,以及记录方式上是一致的. 然而,同样的大脑预测子空间是否泛指参与者、刺激因素和数据集,仍然是以下分析中探讨的一个未决问题。

blocks.en: 4.2 The Learned Low-Rank Subspace Generalizes Across Held-Out Subjects
blocks.zh: 4.2 学习型低倾角子空间泛指所有被搁置的主题

blocks.en: We next asked whether the brain-predictive subspace learned from one group of participants generalizes to an unseen participant (Figure 1 d). If the same low-dimensional embedding directions support neural prediction in a held-out participant, this would indicate that the learned subspace reflects structure shared across individuals rather than idiosyncratic properties of a particular participant’s neural responses.
blocks.zh: 我们接着问,大脑预测的子空间是否从一组参与者那里学到了通俗化到一个看不见的参与者(图1d)。 如果同样的低维嵌入方向支持被搁置参与者的神经预测,这将表明所学习的子空间反映了个人之间共享的结构,而不是特定参与者神经反应的特异性.

blocks.en: Across all three datasets, transferred RRR subspaces recovered near-maximal neural prediction using only tens of dimensions (Figure 3 ). The rank required to reach 99% of peak performance was substantially lower for transferred RRR subspaces than for PCA across datasets, indicating that the cross-participant result cannot be explained simply by retaining the dominant dimensions of variation in the embeddings. We additionally compared transferred subspaces with RRR subspaces learned using the held-out participant’s responses. In the Podcast and fMRI datasets, the transferred subspaces required a comparable number of dimensions—and in some cases fewer—to reach saturation, whereas the Cars 2 dataset showed a larger difference between transferred and participant-inclusive RRR. These results indicate that much of the low-dimensional structure supporting LLM–brain alignment is shared across participants and can be identified without observing neural responses from the participant on whom it is subsequently evaluated.
blocks.zh: 在所有三个数据集中,转移的RRR子空间只利用了几十个维度恢复了近哺乳动物神经预测(图3 )。 转移的RRR子空间达到99%的峰值性能所需级别大大低于跨数据集的PCA,这表明不能仅仅通过保留嵌入物中差异的主要维度来解释跨参与者结果。 我们还将转移的子空间与利用被搁置的参与者的答复而学到的RRR子空间进行了比较。 在Podcast和fMRI数据集中,所转移的子空间需要相当数量的维度——有时更少的维度——才能达到饱和度,而2号机车数据集显示所转移的和包含参与者的RR的相差较大。 这些结果表明,许多支持LLM-大脑对接的低维结构是各参与者共享的,可以在不观察参与者的神经反应的情况下加以识别,而后对其进行评估。

blocks.en: More broadly, the ability to transfer these subspaces across participants motivates a stronger test of their generality: whether the same predictive directions also transfer across datasets, stimuli, and neural recording modalities.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,通过参与者之间传输这些子空间的能力激发了对其通性的一个更强的测试:同样的预测方向是否也跨越数据集,刺激和神经记录模式进行传输.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Dataset Transfer Reveals Shared Brain-Predictive Structure but Is Limited by Stimulus Shift
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨数据集转移 共享的大脑预测结构,但受刺激型移动的限制

blocks.en: Figure 4: Brain-predictive subspaces partially generalize across datasets. (a) Mean convergence curves for within-dataset RRR, cross-dataset transferred RRR, and transferred PCA. (b) Summary of rank–performance efficiency across directed source–target dataset pairs. Transferred RRR is less efficient than within-dataset RRR but consistently more efficient than transferred PCA, indicating partial cross-dataset generalization.
blocks.zh: 图4:大脑预测子空间部分概括跨数据集. (a) 数据集内部的RRR、跨数据集转移的RRR和转移的PCA的平均趋同曲线。 (b) 直接来源目标数据集对的级别-业绩效率摘要。 与数据集内部的RRR相比,转移的RRR效率较低,但始终比转移的PCA效率更高,表明部分跨数据集的通论.

blocks.en: We next asked whether brain-predictive subspaces generalize across datasets differing in participants, stimuli, recording modality, and preprocessing. For each directed source–target pair, we learned an RRR subspace from the source dataset, transferred it to the target embeddings, and fit a new ridge model using only target neural responses such that only the embedding subspace was transferred. Reduced transfer performance could therefore reflect either differences in neurally predictive directions across datasets or differences in the stimulus distributions used to estimate those directions.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问到,大脑预测子空间是否泛指参与者、刺激、记录方式和预处理的不同数据集。 对于每个定向源-目标对,我们从源数据集中学习出一个RRR子空间,将其转移到了目标嵌入,并装入了只使用目标神经响应的新脊模型,这样只传输了嵌入子空间. 因此,转移性能的下降可能反映各数据集神经预测方向的差异,或反映用于估计这些方向的刺激分布的差异。

blocks.en: Transferred RRR remained predictive but recovered performance less efficiently than RRR learned within the target dataset (Figure 4 a). Because these transferred curves saturated more gradually, we summarized normalized rank–performance curves using area under the curve (AUC), with larger AUC indicating more efficient recovery of predictive performance. Across directed dataset pairs and model layers, transferred RRR had lower AUC than within-dataset RRR but significantly higher AUC than transferred PCA for every dataset pair (Figure 4 b). Thus, brain-predictive subspaces contain structure that generalizes across datasets, although this structure is not fully invariant to changes in stimulus and recording setting.
blocks.zh: 转移的RRR仍然具有预测性,但恢复的性能不如目标数据集(图4a)所学的RRR低效. 由于这些转移曲线的饱和程度较快,因此我们利用曲线下的区域(AUC)对正常的级别-性能曲线进行了总结,较大的AUC表示对预测性能进行更有效的恢复。 在所有定向数据集对和模型层中,转移的RRR具有低于数据集内RRR的AUC,但对于每个数据集对等的AUC明显高于转移的PCA(图4b)。 因此,大脑预想子空间包含着跨数据集通通的结构,虽然这种结构并不完全不适应刺激和记录设置的变化.

blocks.en: We next asked whether some of this RRR transfer loss could be explained by differences in the stimuli themselves. To obtain a neural-response-independent measure of cross-dataset representational shift, we performed the same transfer analysis using PCA, which is estimated solely from the stimulus embeddings. The difference between within-dataset and transferred PCA therefore quantifies how much the dominant embedding geometry changes across stimulus sets. Transferred PCA performed significantly worse than within-dataset PCA across all directed dataset comparisons (Figure 4 b), indicating substantial stimulus-dependent variation in embedding geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们接着问,这种RRR转移损失中有些是否可以由刺激本身的差异来解释。 为了获得一个神经-响应-独立度量跨数据集表达变化,我们使用PCA进行了同样的转移分析,这完全通过刺激嵌入法进行估计. 因此,内部数据集与转移的五氯苯甲醚之间的差别,将主要嵌入几何结构在各种刺激组合中发生多大变化。 在所有直接数据集比较中,转移的五氯苯甲醚的性能大大低于数据集内五氯苯甲醚(图4b),表明嵌入几何学方面依赖刺激的巨大差异。

blocks.en: If stimulus distribution shift contributes to the loss of RRR transfer performance, then dataset pairs with a larger PCA transfer gap should also tend to have a larger RRR transfer gap. We therefore compared these two quantities across models, layers, and directed dataset pairs. The RRR transfer gap positively covaried with the corresponding PCA transfer gap (Figure 5 ; Pearson r = 0.58 r=0.58 , n = 184 n=184 ), indicating that poorer transfer of the stimulus-defined embedding space was associated with poorer transfer of the brain-predictive subspace.
blocks.zh: 如果刺激分配转移导致RRR转移性能的丧失,那么具有较大PCA传输缺口的数据集配对也应当倾向于存在较大的RRR传输缺口. 因此,我们通过模型、地层和定向数据集对这两个数量进行比较。 RRR转移缺口与相应的PCA转移缺口(图5;Pearson r = 0.58 r = 0.58,n = 184 n = 184)正相合,表明刺激下定义嵌入空间的转移更差与大脑预测子空间的转移更差有关.

blocks.en: This relationship does not establish that stimulus shift fully explains the RRR transfer gap, since recording modality, preprocessing, or dataset-specific neural representations may also contribute. However, it indicates that stimulus distribution shift is an important source of cross-dataset variability. We next examine these representational differences more directly using interpretable feature decoding.
blocks.zh: 这种关系不能确定刺激转移充分解释了RRR传输缺口,因为记录模式、预处理或数据集特定神经表达也可能有所贡献。 然而,它表明,刺激分配转变是跨数据集可变性的一个重要来源。 我们接下来更直接地利用可解释的特征解码来审查这些代表差异。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Cross-dataset RRR transfer loss covaries with stimulus-dependent PCA shift. Across models, layers, and directed dataset pairs, the gap between within-dataset and transferred RRR performance is positively correlated with the corresponding PCA transfer gap ( r = 0.58 r=0.58 , n = 184 n=184 ). Each point represents a model–layer combination for one directed source–target transfer.
blocks.zh: 图5:具有依赖刺激的五氯苯甲醚转移的跨数据集RRR转移损失库。 跨模型、分层和定向数据集对等,数据集内部和转移的RRR性能之间的差距与相应的PCA传输差距(r=0.58 r=0.58;n=184 n=184)正相关. 每个点代表一个定向源-目标传输的模型-层组合.

blocks.en: 4.4 FMRI and IEEG Aligned Low-Rank Subspaces Emphasize Different Linguistic Information
blocks.zh: 4.4 FMRI和IEEG 相通低亮分空间 强调不同的语言信息

blocks.en: Having shown that RRR recovers neural predictivity in far fewer dimensions than PCA, we next asked what information distinguishes these two low-dimensional spaces. PCA preserves directions of greatest variance in the model embeddings, whereas RRR selects directions specifically for their ability to predict neural responses. Comparing feature decodability between equally sized RRR and PCA subspaces therefore asks which linguistic information is preferentially preserved when the embedding space is constrained by neural prediction rather than by variance alone. Greater decodability from RRR does not imply that a feature itself drives neural prediction, but indicates enrichment of that feature, or correlated information, in the brain-predictive subspace.
blocks.zh: 在证明RRR在比PCA小得多的维度中恢复了神经预测性之后,我们接下来问,哪些信息能区分这两个低维空间. 五氯苯甲醚在模型嵌入物中保留了最大差异的方向,而RRR则专门选择方向,用于预测神经反应的能力. 因此,将同样大小的RRR和PCA子空间之间的特征可解码性进行比较,可以询问当嵌入空间受到神经预测而不是单因差异而受到限制时,优先保留哪些语言信息。 从RRR得到更大的可解码性并不意味着一个特征本身会驱动神经预测,而是表明该特征的丰富性,或者相关的信息在大脑预测子空间.

blocks.en: Across datasets, several features showed preferential decoding from the RRR subspace. For example, sentence position and GPT-2 next-word prediction entropy were more accessible from RRR than PCA at low ranks across all three datasets (Figure 6 a). Word concreteness, however, was preferentially represented in the fMRI-derived RRR subspace at low ranks, but showed no corresponding enrichment in either iEEG dataset. Thus, the learned subspaces preserve both shared and dataset-specific linguistic information.
blocks.zh: 在整个数据集中,有多个功能显示出RRR子空间的优先解码. 例如,所有三个数据集的句子位置和GPT-2下个词预测 en比PCA在低位更容易从RRR获取(图6a). 然而,在fMRI衍生的RRR子空间中,文字混凝土在低等位置得到优待,但在iEEG数据集中都没有显示相应的丰富. 因此,所学的子空间既保存共享的又保存数据集特有的语言信息.

blocks.en: We next asked whether these dataset differences showed systematic structure. If RRR is capturing meaningful properties of the neural measurements rather than an arbitrary predictive compression, datasets sharing a recording modality should prioritize similar features. Consistent with this prediction, enrichment profiles were strongly correlated between the two iEEG datasets (Podcast versus Cars 2: ( r = 0.70 r=0.70 ); Figure 6 b), but showed little correspondence between either iEEG dataset and fMRI (Podcast versus fMRI: ( r = − 0.11 r=-0.11 ); Cars 2 versus fMRI: ( r = − 0.12 r=-0.12 )).
blocks.zh: 我们接着问这些数据集的差异是否显示出系统的结构。 如果 RRR 正在捕捉神经测量的有意义的属性,而不是任意的预测压缩,共享一个记录模式的数据集应该优先考虑类似的特性. 根据这一预测,两个iEEG数据集(Podcast vers 2. (r = 0.70 r = 0.70;图6 b)之间的浓缩剖面密切相关,但很少显示iEEG数据集与fMRI(Podcast vers. = − 0.11 r =-0.11;cars 2 vers : (r = − 0.12 r =-0.12))之间的对应关系。

blocks.en: This pattern provides convergent support for the interpretation that RRR is isolating meaningful brain-predictive structure. Despite differences in participants and stimuli, the two iEEG datasets emphasize similar linguistic information, while both differ from fMRI. It also complements the cross-dataset transfer results: stimulus shift contributes to transfer loss, but datasets may additionally differ in which components of the embedding space are selected by neural supervision.
blocks.zh: 这种模式为RRR正在隔离有意义的大脑预测结构的解释提供了趋同的支持. 尽管参与者和刺激不同,两个iEEG数据集强调类似的语言信息,而两者都与fMRI不同. 它还补充了跨数据集转移结果:刺激转移有助于转移损失,但数据集可能额外不同,嵌入空间的哪些组件是通过神经监督选择的.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Linguistic feature enrichment differs across neural datasets. (a) Relative decoding advantage of RRR over PCA across ranks for example features. Positive values indicate greater decodability from RRR; negative values indicate greater decodability from PCA. Details of computation in A.3.1. (b) Feature-enrichment profiles are strongly correlated between the two iEEG datasets but not between either iEEG dataset and fMRI.
blocks.zh: 图6:不同神经数据集的语言特征丰富度不同. 例如,RRR相对于PCA具有不同等级的相对解码优势。 阳性值表示来自RRR的更可解码;阴性值表示来自PCA的更可解码. A.3.1中的计算细节。 (b) 特性浓缩剖面图在两个iEEG数据集之间密切相关,但在iEEEG数据集和fMRI之间没有关联。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results show that LLM–brain alignment during naturalistic language processing is supported by a surprisingly low-dimensional subset of the embedding space. Across datasets, models, and layers, neural prediction saturated using only tens of dimensions, and these brain-predictive directions differed from the principal axes of embedding variance. The learned subspaces generalized strongly across held-out participants and partially across datasets, with cross-dataset differences associated with both stimulus-dependent shifts in embedding geometry and differences in the linguistic information emphasized across recording modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,自然语言处理过程中的LLM-大脑对接得到了嵌入空间一个出人意料的低维子集的支持. 整个数据集,模型,和地层,神经预测 饱和仅使用数十个维度, 这些大脑预测方向 不同于嵌入差异的主要轴。 学习到的分空间在被搁置的参与者之间和部分在数据集之间广泛分布,在嵌入几何学方面依赖刺激的变化和在各种记录方式中强调的语言信息的差异,都具有跨数据集差异。

blocks.en: Beyond establishing the existence and generality of this low-rank structure, the framework provides a way to probe which components of large model representations contribute most strongly to neural prediction. Because RRR identifies directions that are selected specifically for their ability to predict neural responses, comparing the information available in the RRR and PCA subspaces can reveal representational mismatches between the two spaces. For example, we find that some stimulus-level properties, including volume (Figure 6 a), can be decoded more accurately from the RRR space than from a comparable PCA space. This should not be interpreted as evidence that the language model represents acoustic volume: the model receives only the transcript. Instead, the RRR subspace is likely preserving linguistic features that covary with acoustic properties of the stimulus which is useful for predicting responses to heard speech. This example highlights a broader interpretational challenge for neural encoding models built from high-dimensional language representations. Linguistic, semantic, syntactic, discourse, and acoustic properties are highly correlated in naturalistic stimuli, such that successful neural prediction does not by itself identify which underlying feature is causally responsible for alignment.
blocks.zh: 除了确定这种低等结构的存在和普遍性之外,该框架还提供了一种方法来探究大型模型表述的哪些组成部分对神经预测的贡献最大。 因为RRR识别了专门为其预测神经响应能力所选择的方向,比较RRR和PCA子空间中可得到的信息可以揭示出两个空间之间的代表错配. 例如,我们发现,一些刺激级属性,包括体积(图6a),可以从RRR空间中比从相类似的PCA空间中更准确地解码出. 这不应被解释为语言模型代表音量的证据:模型只收到音量记录. 反之,RRR子空间可能保留语言特征,这些特征与刺激的声学特性交织在一起,对预测听到的语音的反应是有用的。 这个例子凸显出对由高维语言表示所构建的神经编码模型的更广泛的解释挑战. 语言学,语义学,综合学,论语学,和声学性质在自然学刺激学中是高度相通的,因此成功的神经预测本身并不能自行确定哪个基本特征对调合有因果关系.

blocks.en: An open question remains as to what is limiting the dimensionality of this aligned subspace. One possibility is that coarse neural recordings which we typically have access to in human neuroscience contain little signal and we are in fact recovering it well with tens of dimensions. Another possibility though is that the model embedding representations are missing some portion of the true representational signal contained in this neural data. While our analysis cannot answer this question, it does provide evidence that the primary features of LLM embeddings which align with the neural data are not equivalent to the principal axes of the embeddings, demonstrating a divide in the representational geometry of the two systems.
blocks.zh: 关于限制这一对齐子空间的维度的问题仍然存在。 一种可能性是,我们通常在人类神经科学中接触到的粗糙的神经录相中包含的信号很少,事实上,我们正用几十个维度很好地恢复它。 不过,另一种可能性是,嵌入式表示模型缺少了这个神经数据中包含的真正表示信号的一部分. 虽然我们的分析无法回答这个问题,但它确实提供了证据表明,与神经数据相匹配的LLM嵌入的主要特征不等同于嵌入的主要轴,表明两个系统在代表几何上存在分化.

blocks.en: A.2.1 RRR fitting and rank evaluation
blocks.zh: A.2.1 RRR的配置和等级评价

blocks.en: Ranks generally doubled in powers of 2 to the available embedding-dimensionality endpoint. At each rank, a new ridge encoding model was fit after projection. Ridge penalties were selected by inner cross-validation from a 25-value scale-aware grid. Performance was measured as Pearson correlation between predicted and observed held-out responses. For iEEG, correlations across lags were averaged in Fisher-(z) space to obtain per-electrode performance.

blocks.en: A.2.2 Construction of the fMRI RRR subspace
blocks.zh: A.2.2 建造fMRI RRR子空间

blocks.en: For fMRI, the initial RRR fit operated on the complete four-delay finite impulse response design, yielding a separate input-factor block for each delay. We combined these blocks to obtain a (k)-dimensional subspace in the original embedding coordinates. For each of the first (k) RRR components, coefficients were normalized across the four delays and scaled by the corresponding singular value of the ridge model’s fitted training responses. This weighting gives components with greater fitted prediction energy greater influence while preserving their distribution across delays.
blocks.zh: 对于fMRI,最初的RRR相配运行在完整的四延迟有限冲动响应设计上,对每次延迟产生单独的输入-因子块. 我们把这些区块结合在一起,以获得原始嵌入坐标中的(k)-维分空间. 对于第一个(k)RRR的每个组成部分,在四个延误中都使系数正常化,并用脊道模型所适应的训练反应的相应单值来作缩放。 这种加权方式使具有更大适应性预测能的组件在保持其延迟分布的同时,具有更大的影响力.

blocks.en: The four weighted blocks were concatenated, and their leading (k) left singular vectors were used as an orthonormal embedding basis. At each rank, embeddings were projected into this basis, the four-delay design was reconstructed, and a new ridge encoding model was fit for held-out evaluation.
blocks.zh: 四个加权区块被收缩了,它们的主(k)左单向量被用作正向嵌入基. 在每个级别上,都将嵌入物投射入这个基础,重建了四延设计,并配有新的脊道编码模型来进行被搁置的评价.

blocks.zh: A.2.3 语言特征解码细节

blocks.en: Stimulus words were annotated with the available lexical, syntactic, semantic, discourse, timing, and pause features. At each rank, embeddings were projected separately into the RRR and PCA spaces. Continuous features were decoded using ridge regression and evaluated by Pearson correlation; categorical features were decoded using class-balanced logistic regression and evaluated by balanced accuracy. Features unavailable for a given dataset were omitted from that dataset’s analysis. A complete list of decoded features and their sources is provided below.
blocks.zh: 刺激词被附加了现有的语法、同义语、语义、话语、时间和暂停等特征。 在每个级别上,嵌入物分别投放到RRR和PCA空间. 连续特性采用脊回向法进行解码,并按皮尔逊相关性加以评价;绝对特性采用类平衡后勤回向法进行解码,并按平衡准确性加以评价。 该数据集的分析中省略了某一数据集不具备的特征。 下文提供了解码特征及其出处的完整清单。

blocks.en: A.3 Saturation rank definition
blocks.zh: A.3 饱和等级定义

blocks.en: Our goal was to estimate the minimum rank required to recover near-maximal neural predictive performance. In principle, this could be defined separately for every neural target (voxel or electrode). Individual target-level rank–performance curves are noisy, however, making target-specific saturation estimates unstable. Conversely, defining saturation from only the mean performance across targets can obscure heterogeneity across the neural-target distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是估算恢复近乎哺乳动物神经预测性能所需的最低等级。 原则上,这可以针对每个神经目标(voxel或电极)分别定义. 然而,单个目标级别-性能曲线很吵,使得特定目标饱和度估计不稳定。 反之,仅从不同目标的平均性能来定义饱和度,可能模糊神经-目标分布的异性.

blocks.en: We therefore characterized saturation at the level of the target-performance distribution. At each evaluated rank, we computed the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, and 90th percentiles of held-out target performance and tracked each quantile across the rank sweep. For each quantile, we defined its maximum as the highest performance attained across evaluated ranks. The overall saturation rank was then the minimum rank at which every informative quantile reached at least 99% of its respective maximum performance.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们在目标业绩分配一级表现饱和。 在每个评估级别上,我们计算第10,第25,第50,第75和第90个百分位被搁置的目标性能,并跟踪每个四分位数横扫级别。 对于每一类,我们将其最大程度定义为在被评定级别上取得的最高业绩。 总体饱和等级是最低等级,在最低等级中,每个提供信息的四分位数至少达到各自最大业绩的99%。

blocks.en: Quantile curves whose maximum performance did not exceed 0.005 were excluded because they contained almost no positive predictive performance for which a recovery rank could be meaningfully defined. Requiring all remaining quantiles to reach threshold prevents saturation from being determined solely by high-performing targets or by changes in the mean and instead requires near-maximal recovery across a broad portion of the neural-target distribution.
blocks.zh: 最大性能不超过0.005的量子曲线被排除在外,因为这些曲线几乎不含可有意义地确定恢复等级的正预测性能。 要求所有剩余的四分位数达到阈值,防止饱和完全由高性能目标或平均值变化决定,而是需要在神经-目标分布的一大部分中进行近乎极限的恢复.

blocks.en: Because the estimated saturation rank depends on the chosen recovery threshold, we additionally evaluated the sensitivity of our conclusions to alternative thresholds.
blocks.zh: 由于估计的饱和度级别取决于所选择的回收阈值,我们进一步评价了我们的结论对替代阈值的敏感性.

blocks.en: A.5 Significance Selection
blocks.zh: A.5 重大选择

blocks.en: Neural targets were selected using held-out predictions from full-embedding ridge encoding models. For iEEG, we used five contiguous word folds and evaluated each electrode using its best-lag prediction correlation, defined as the sampled time point relative to word onset at which the correlation between predicted and observed neural activity was greatest. Null distributions were generated by circularly shifting responses within held-out folds. Best-lag (p)-values were corrected across electrodes using the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure. Once an electrode was selected, all sampled lags for that electrode were retained as separate RRR targets. Main analyses used the union of electrodes selected across configured model and layer significance runs.
blocks.zh: 利用从全嵌入地脊编码模型中得出的被搁置的预测选择了神经目标. 对于iEEG,我们使用5个相接的单词折叠,并使用每个电极的最佳lag预测相关性来评价每个电极,被定义为相对于词发的被抽样时间点,在该时间点上,预测和观测到的神经活性间的相关性最大. 零散的分布是通过在搁置的折叠内循环转移反应产生的。 使用Benjamini-Hochberg程序对电极进行校正。 一旦选取出一个电极,该电极的所有被取样的后遗症都被保留为单独的RRR目标. 主要分析利用了经过所配置的模型和地层意义运行所选定的电极结合。

blocks.en: For fMRI, voxel significance was assessed using predictions from models that held out complete training sessions, each consisting of unique stories and one repeated test story. The repeated test story was excluded from target selection. Null distributions were generated by circularly shifting responses within each story, followed by Benjamini–Hochberg correction. Significant voxels were retained as RRR targets.
blocks.zh: 对fMRI来说,通过举办完整的培训课程的模型的预测,评估了voxel意义,每个模型包括独特的故事和一个重复的测试故事。 重复的测试故事被排除在目标选择之外. 每个故事中通过循环变化的响应生成了虚无的分布,然后是Benjamini-Hochberg校正. 作为RRR目标,保留了大量的活塞.
